records.text: In an April 13, 2018 text, Candace Owens told Charlie Kirk that Kanye West was writing a philosophy book called Break the Simulation
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: This is April 13th, 2018. This is what I said to him just so you can kind of get the vibe of what was going on. I said, "Yo, Kanye West writing a philosophy book called 'Break the Simulation.' We need him, Charlie (Charlie Kirk).

verification.notes: The source transcript at about 04:27 shows Owens introducing an on-screen text exchange as dated April 13, 2018 and reading her message to Charlie Kirk that Kanye West was writing a philosophy book called Break the Simulation. A contemporaneous report published April 13, 2018 independently confirms that West had announced a philosophy book with that title. The displayed private message is primary evidence supplied by Owens and has not been independently authenticated, so confidence is medium rather than high.
